notes.title: Major Update – “The Harbor”
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to one of the biggest updates yet! Reworked, reloaded, and refined the experience – and now it's time for you to dive into the fog.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]New Map: “The Habor”[/b][/p][p]
Say hello to [i]The Habor[/i], a gritty, fog-drenched harbor where danger hides behind every container.
There are no weapons at spawn – you’ll need to explore, scavenge, and secure your gear before the chaos starts.
The low visibility makes this a tense, tactical experience. Who’s breathing behind that crate? Friend or foe? You’ll have to find out the hard way.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Performance Upgrades[/b][/p][p]
Cleaned up, tightened code, and squeezed out unnecessary overhead to give you a smoother ride across all machines.[/p][list][*][p][b]Faster loading times[/b] – spend more time playing, less time watching loading bars.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced VRAM usage[/b] – your GPU will thank you, especially on longer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FSR updated[/b] – now supports a wider range of graphics cards and brings real FPS gains, not just better anti-aliasing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More FPS [/b]- shooting smoother with +-50% more Real*FPS [/p][/*][/list][p]*without DLSS or FSR [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Gameplay & Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the infamous pistol reload bug. No more empty click-clicks in the heat of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized player spawn zones.[/p][/*][*][p]General polish and tweaks across lighting, fog rendering, and map memory usage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking Ahead…[/b][/p][p]
The fog hasn’t even cleared yet, and already working on the next big thing.[/p][p]Coming up in the next major update:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]brand-new map[/b] is in the works – fresh terrain, fresh chaos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]GUI improvements[/b] to make your interactions smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Networking optimizations[/b] to make multiplayer more stable, snappier, and rage-quit resistant.[/p][/*][*][p]Plus: a handful of smaller tweaks, fixes, and polish to keep everything feeling crisp.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Final Notes[/b]
As always: new content means new unknowns. If you find bugs, please report them — preferably [i]before[/i] they start a rebellion.[/p][p][/p][p]
The fog is thick, the docks are dangerous, and your enemies are lurking. Good luck out there.[/p]

notes.title: Morphing Bullets is now available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h1]Morphing Bullets is officially live on Steam.[/h1]

This marks the beginning of our Early Access journey — a phase focused on refining gameplay, gathering feedback, and growing the game together with the community.

All core features and content planned for launch are ready — including maps, characters, and weapons. But Early Access also means things may still break, glitch, or surprise you in ways we didn’t intend.

If you run into issues or have suggestions, we’d love to hear from you — every report helps make the game better.

[b]Before you jump in:[/b]
Please read the [FAQ] — it contains important info on how to set up multiplayer, how dedicated servers work, and how to avoid known bugs and glitches.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3558140/discussions/1/597398346071565119/]FAQ[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3558140/discussions/1/597402121489454143/]Known Issues & Quick Tips[/url]


Thank you for your support — now go cause some chaos!
[b]Morph smart. Shoot fast. Adapt faster.[/b]

notes.title: Early Access Is Coming – What To Expect
notes.notes:
The Early Access release is just around the corner 

[b]— May 30th, 2025, 17:00 CESZ — [/b]

So far, development has gone smoother than expected — no game-breaking bugs in sight, no massive scope creeps (yet), and even a few features that were meant to come later already snuck their way in.

Here’s a quick look at what’s ready, what’s coming, and what you might want to prepare for.


[b]What’s Ready at Launch?[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 unique maps and 3 fully playable game modes
 Warehouse chaos, spooky parking garage, and a military base — all ready for action.

[*] 9 weapons + 1 medkit
From precise tools of destruction to full-on crowd-control madness.

[*] 5 distinct characters, each with their own stats and Aura Skills
Sprint faster, tank more damage, regenerate, fade into the background, or shield the whole team.

[*] 7 unique morphs
Trap enemies, slow them down, scout their position, set them on fire, blow them sky-high,
laser them out of existence, ... and just generally ruin someone’s day.

[*] DLSS support 
For raytracing users and everyone else — but let’s be honest, a decent PC still helps with raytracing.
FSR support is also in the works and partially included at launch.

[*] Lightweight Perk System
A passive system that evolves with your level.
[/list]


[b]And Now... the Early Access Disclaimer[/b]
Let’s keep it real: This is Early Access. That means...

[list]
[*] Bugs — some silly, some frustrating, some... oddly charming

[*] Crashes — feature, not a bug.

[*] Ugly Balancing — because someone has to suffer

[*] Unfinished features — or things that look finished but secretly aren’t

[*] Performance dips — even though we hit stable FPS across our low and high-end systems, your specific hardware will surprise us
[/list]

[b]So:[/b]
Help shape the game. 
We need your help to catch the stuff we missed.
Whether it's a tiny glitch, balancing feedback, or just weird behavior — report it. Every bit counts.

Join the community. Break things. Laugh. Rage. Suggest stuff.


See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Dev Preview – Today: Aura Weapons - "When Chaos Finds You"
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[b]Today a look to the Aura Weapons.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/87374446f0de2d16e75a6b19406b17657932bd85.png[/img]

They don’t follow the rules.
They appear when they want.
And when they do… they change everything.

Aura Weapons are powerful tools of destruction that appear randomly during matches – or sometimes not at all. You can't rely on them, but when one shows up, you better grab it fast.

[b]What Makes Aura Weapons Special?[/b]
No reloading. No mercy.
Aura Weapons are high-powered and fire until they break – no clips, no cool-downs.

[b]Short lifespan, big impact.[/b]
These weapons don’t last long, but they hit hard. Use them wisely before they vanish.

[b]Spawn behavior.[/b]
Completely random. You might see one every match. Or none at all.
It’s chaos. Controlled by design.

[b]Grenades.[/b]
Grenades are also part of the Aura Weapon system – and yes, they hurt.


Aura Weapons add another layer of unpredictability and fun to every match.
They reward map control, sharp eyes, and fast reactions.

You won’t always get one.
But when you do – make it count.


➡️ Got feedback or questions? Drop by the Steam forum and leave me a message!

Stay sharp.

notes.title: The Early Access Release Date Is Set!
notes.notes:
Yes, it’s happening. We finally have a date for the Early Access launch of Morphing Bullets!

notes.title: Dev Preview – Today: The Maps
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

What would Morphing Bullets be without places to fight, transform, and explode into chaos?
Let’s take a look at the three maps that will be available when Early Access launches.

Each one is designed to offer a different kind of tension, whether it’s tight close-quarters or wide-open danger zones.


[b]The Warehouse[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/4bb185dbad853a6d8d3a766b557a651e0599e6d1.jpg[/img]

Dark, dusty, and full of danger.
This labyrinth of high shelves and narrow corridors offers great ambush spots and vertical movement.
But don’t get too comfortable on the ground floor – it’s covered in thick fog that limits visibility and makes for some surprise encounters.


[b]Abandoned Parking Garage[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/faf29118281e0f4485168d6ed39b5629d4ada452.jpg[/img]

Abandoned, eerie, and full of dead ends.
This level brings a claustrophobic horror vibe, with dark stairways, tight passages, and the constant feeling that you’re not alone.
Perfect for players who love stealth, surprise attacks – or just getting spooked by sudden morphs.


[b]The Military Base[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/74d618763047f95a1d2e1a3eaa83047adcd1821d.jpg[/img]

This is the largest map so far – open, loud, and intense.
You’ll hear distant war sounds, spot guard towers, and navigate a huge central building.
But watch out: there’s not much cover, and hiding is nearly impossible.
This is the place where fast movement and sharp aim really matter.

Each map has been designed with different strategies and playstyles in mind – from sneaky stalkers to all-out attackers.

Which one will be your home turf?

More previews are on the way soon – stay tuned and let us know what you think!

➡️ Got feedback or questions? Drop by the Steam forum and leave me a message!

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Dev Preview – Today: The Little Things
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

While the big features tend to grab the spotlight, there’s a lot happening behind the scenes in Morphing Bullets.
Today, we’re shining a light on some of the smaller systems and hidden details that help shape the overall experience.


🧬 The Perk System
Yes, there will be perks – small passive bonuses that enhance your character's abilities. The system is tied to your player level and works fully automatically.
You don’t need to equip or manage anything. Just play, level up, and benefit.
Perks are optional and can be disabled by the server admin. The system will roll out during the Early Access phase.


🌐 Server Setup
You can play via Steam Peer-to-Peer or on a dedicated server – your choice!
Both options are fully customizable, allowing control over match length, map rotation, team setup, and more.

Dedicated servers won’t be available via SteamCMD at launch.
However, the server files are included directly in the game folder and can be uploaded to any host of your choice.


🧱 Server-Based Progression
Progression is server- or host-specific.
That means: if you switch servers, your level and stats reset to that server’s own data – keeping things fair and clean.


🔼 Level Cap
The current max level is 300.
(Yes, that’s quite a grind. And no, you don’t need to hit it to be good.)


🌍 Language Customization
You can add your own language or edit existing ones.
Want to rename a weapon? Fix a typo? Or just change everything to pirate slang? Go for it.
Language files are open and easily editable – and yes, we love that kind of creative chaos.


That’s it for this round of “The Little Things”.
Sometimes, it's the subtle stuff that really makes a game feel complete – and we’re building a system that lets players and communities shape it how they want.

More updates are just around the corner – stay tuned!

➡️ Got feedback? You know where to find us: the Steam forums are always open.

Thanks for following along.

notes.title: Dev Preview – Today: The Characters
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It’s time for another sneak peek as we gear up for the Early Access launch.

Today, i introducing the five playable characters you’ll get to know (and probably love or curse) on the battlefield.

Each character in Morphing Bullets brings their own unique stats and Aura Skill to the fight – so choosing your favorite isn’t just about style, it’s about how you play.


Here’s who’s waiting for you:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/34a641907109b6bee760add3f21e6888baf03056.png[/img]

👟 [b]Brunhilde[/b]
Fastest sprinter in the game. Great for flanking and quick repositioning.
Aura Skill: Extra Life – restores health.

🛡️ [b]Elon[/b]
Tanky and tough – higher health pool means he’s hard to take down.
Aura Skill: Extended Morph Time – morphs stay active longer.

🔧 [b]Mordo[/b]
Heals himself passively over time, making him hard to finish off.
Aura Skill: Personal Shield – a bubble just for you.

💨 [b]Rondo[/b]
Built for stamina – more running, more staying mobile.
Aura Skill: Translucent – become hard to see for a short time.

💥 [b]Seth[/b]
Pure firepower – does more damage with every shot and punsh.
Aura Skill: Group Shield – protect your entire team in a pinch.


Each character plays differently, and depending on your team setup, they can complement each other in fun and chaotic ways. Which one will be your main?


More dev updates are coming soon – stay sharp!
➡️ Got feedback? You know where to find us: the Steam forums are always open.

Thanks for following along.

notes.title: Dev Preview – Today: The Lobby
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]
Today, I want to give you the very first sneak peek into Morphing Bullets. Over the next few weeks leading up to the Early Access release, I’ll be sharing more behind-the-scenes looks and gameplay insights with you.



[b]Let’s kick things off with the lobby [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545942/d0de9261290fa3866dbe72f013168077a1bc7d33.png[/img]


Now sure, a 3D lobby isn’t unheard of – but instead of staring at a static player list, you’ll be in a proper space between battles. Here you can chill out, watch ongoing matches as a spectator, and prepare for your next round.

Once your match ends, you’ll automatically return here. It’s also the place where you’ll pick your team before the next fight begins.

In this area, admins can also start the next match manually or show naughty players the door.

More previews are on the way soon – stay tuned and let us know what you think!

➡️ Got feedback or questions? Drop by the Steam forum and leave me a message!

[b]Thanks for being part of this journey.[/b]
